metadata.source: Synthetic training telemetry; values are not real credentials

sinks: Fork-owned Maven wrapper executed by bash ./mvnw -B verify inside the privileged build job
Long-lived canary token present in the privileged job environment

events.detail: Workflow secret changed from the ephemeral GITHUB_TOKEN to a long-lived personal access token to work around CI friction
Pull request modified the Maven wrapper (mvnw) that the privileged build job later invokes
bash ./mvnw -B verify executed the fork-owned wrapper, which attempted to fetch a remote payload; request was simulated and blocked
The same personal access token was reused to invite a disposable collaborator to a related repository
Disposable collaborator added to the related repository using the misused token
Malicious workflow pushed on a short-lived branch and the branch deleted immediately after the run started
All repository secrets stringified, symmetrically encrypted, wrapped with a hard-coded public key, and uploaded as a workflow artifact for retrieval
Trusted v1 tag of a setup action moved to a malicious commit originating from a disposable fork
Composite-action pivot executed the hijacked setup action inside another project's CI and exposed that project's runner token
All existing tags of the changed-files action rewritten to a malicious commit, executing in every consumer's CI
Disposable account forked a high-value target repository whose workflows referenced the rewritten action tag
Third-party researcher disclosed the chain; maintainers removed the vulnerable workflow and rotated credentials
